output.summary: Annual flowering plant thought to be native to western South America. Its pale violet, bell-shaped flowers open for only a few hours each day, later developing a deeply lobed, lantern-like covering around the fruit. Introduced widely, it commonly occurs as a weed of cultivated and waste ground.
output.edibilityNote: Accounts conflict: cooked tender leaves, berries and processed seed jelly are eaten, but the whole plant and berries have also been described as toxic.
